summary: HSBC filed a 6-K confirming same-day repurchases under its buy-back announced 5 August 2026, executed via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. On UK Venues it bought 10,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted 15.4765 (high 15.6220/low 15.3860); on the Hong Kong exchange it bought 332,000 shares at HK$166.0649 weighted. Cumulative buy-back totals 27,255,814 shares for roughly US$562.3m. Shares are cancelled; issued capital stands at 17,160,032,183 shares, with Hong Kong cancellations lagging. Watch execution pace versus authorization and any total-voting-rights updates.
